item.description: Remixed 2000s nostalgia powered by today’s skate tech The Skate Mixxa channels the bold vibes of the early days when skate shoes were all about making a statement. We’re pulling from the Vans archives to drop a reimagined silhouette that brings a bit of nostalgia. With oversized ollie panels and DURACAP underlays for a pop of color that can weather a few drops, this sneaker fuses today’s tech with a retro aesthetic. Low-top puffy sneakers give you a retro look Skate-specific features for next-level durability and performance SickStick™ gum rubber gives you lasting grip that won’t quit Upper combines leather, polyethylene, and mesh for style and strength Stitched-on cupsole wraps the whole shoe for insane durability Reinforced toe cap for extra protection up front DURACAP™ ollie panel fortifies high-wear spots Lightly padded footbed keeps you comfy with every push Puffy collar and padded tongue bring that extra support Wide laces add to the classic vibe Color-blocked outsole delivers a unique twist on the design
item.name: Vans Skate Mixxa Skateboard Shoe - Athletic White/Multi

item.description: The Chukka Low Sidestripe, designed by the Vans skate team and inspired by classics like the Authentic and the Chukka Boot, brings a new heritage aesthetic to this old school skate shoe. Featuring our iconic sidestripe, this low top silhouette blends classic materials like sturdy suede and 6 oz twill with Vans original waffle outsoles made of a rubber that offers grip and support. Inside, enhanced sockliners provide superior cushioning and impact protection. Along with Pro Vulc Lite construction for lightweight comfort and flexibility, the Chukka Low Sidestripe delivers the best in boardfeel, flex, and traction. ENHANCED CUSHIONING - Enhanced sockliners offer superior cushioning and impact protection. CLASSIC GUM RUBBER GRIP - The Van Doren Gum Rubber Compound, made of a rubber that offers grip and support, is what attracted skaters to Vans in the first place. This is the Sole of Skateboarding. ULTIMATE BOARDFEEL, FLEX, AND GRIP - A lighter version of our iconic construction, Pro Vulc Lite features single-wrapped, high-wall vulcanization along with drop-in cushioning. Style #VN0A5KQZB8C1
item.name: Vans Chukka Low Sidestripe Skateboard Shoe - Black/Black/White

item.description: Every time Rowan Zorilla steps on his board, it’s a live performance. He makes the most difficult skating look effortless, and his first signature shoe was designed with that in mind. The Rowan may look laid back on its surface, but dig a little deeper and the layers of complexity begin to reveal themselves. DURACAP™ reinforcement rubber underlays in high wear areas offer maximum durability, and the new SICKSTICK™ gum rubber outsoles provide next-level grip. Plus, with the new POPCUSH™ energy return sockliners that feature superior cushioning and impact protection while helping to lessen leg fatigue for longer skate sessions, the Rowan lets you put on a live performance of your own. It is made with sturdy suede and 10 oz canvas uppers. UNRIVALED DURABILITY - Reinforced DURACAP™ underlays in high-wear areas add unrivaled durability to prolong the life of each shoe. LEGENDARY GRIP - Our new, proprietary SickStick™ gum rubber compound is our stickiest rubber yet. POPCUSH CUSHIONING - Our best cushioning and impact protection. POPCUSH™ energy return footbeds help protect your feet while helping to lessen leg fatigue for longer skate sessions. Style #VN0A5JIC6BT

item.description: Lizzie Armanto Pro Model Shoe! The Lizzie Low, a takedown of Lizzie Armanto’s signature skate shoe, breaks as much new ground as Lizzie herself with a unique solution to the universal problems of skate shoes—a better-fitting, more durable, and sustainability-conscious solution for all skateboarders. Created with thoughful materials and inclusivity in mind, Lizzie and Vans are proud to deliver something completely different for a new generation of skateboarders. FEATURES SUSTAINABILITY-CONSCIOUS MATERIALS - The upper (the quarter panel, tongue, and lining) is made from recycled polyester, organically grown cotton, and suede.Vans leather products support responsible manufacturing via the Leather Working Group. UNIVERSAL FIT: This performance fit was designed by Lizzie to meet the needs of a wider range of skateboarders. The stretch tongue straps offer added lockdown and tongue stabilization. BOARDFEEL AND IMPACT PROTECTION: Made using VR3CUSH™ foam, a 70% biobased PU foam (Fates™) partially sourced from plants per the ASTM D6866-16 reference standard, The Lizzie offers a lower-profile sockliner that provides the boardfeel and impact protection you demand. LEGENDARY GRIP: The bottom plate design utilizes forefoot flex grooves, zonal waffle lugs for durability and support, plus SickStick™ rubber (a proprietary compound containing at least 55% responsibly sourced natural rubber obtained from sources that follow proven sustainable practices with the intention of reducing impacts on the planet) paired with a micro-waffle pattern, and gives you the grip you expect from Vans with a broken-in feel right out of the box. DURABILITY: DURACAP™ reinforcements in high-wear areas, plus a thicker 3D molded DURACAP™ toe cap, provide extra durability.
item.name: Vans The Lizzie Low (Vintage White/Black)

item.description: The Sk8-Hi was a game changer as the first high-top skate shoe to break onto the scene. With a padded collar for ankle support and reinforced toe caps, it remains a style like no other. The Sk8-Hi was Vans second model to showcase the Vans Sidestripe, and its bold design has remained iconic ever since.
item.name: Vans Sk8-Hi Color Theory Shoes

item.description: The Era hit the streets 50 years ago. Designed by skate pioneers, it was Vans first shoe made for skateboarding. An evolved take on the Authentic the Era’s trusted silhouette and performance-focused upgrades—from the padded collar to the grippy rubber outsole—helped take skateboarding to the next level in the late ‘70s. Over the decades that followed, it remained one of Vans' most sought-after styles. But now, the Era is out of the back catalog and back in the streets. Modernized with our latest skate tech, today’s Skate Era is reinforced and refined for the next generation.
item.name: Vans Skate Era Mauve Mist Shoes

item.description: Celebrating 25 years of Geoff Rowleys legacy, the Skate Rowley Shoe is a nod to his original signature shoe while pushing skate culture forward. Built on the Rowley Pro foundation and redesigned for todays skaters, this vulcanized classic delivers everything modern skateboarders need. Honoring a skate icon who reshaped shoe design, this anniversary edition stays true to its roots while keeping up with the demands of the next generation.
item.name: Vans Skate Rowley Shoes

new_items.description: Lizzie Armanto Pro Model Shoe! The Lizzie Low, a takedown of Lizzie Armanto’s signature skate shoe, breaks as much new ground as Lizzie herself with a unique solution to the universal problems of skate shoes—a better-fitting, more durable, and sustainability-conscious solution for all skateboarders. Created with thoughful materials and inclusivity in mind, Lizzie and Vans are proud to deliver something completely different for a new generation of skateboarders. FEATURES SUSTAINABILITY-CONSCIOUS MATERIALS - The upper (the quarter panel, tongue, and lining) is made from recycled polyester, organically grown cotton, and suede.Vans leather products support responsible manufacturing via the Leather Working Group. UNIVERSAL FIT: This performance fit was designed by Lizzie to meet the needs of a wider range of skateboarders. The stretch tongue straps offer added lockdown and tongue stabilization. BOARDFEEL AND IMPACT PROTECTION: Made using VR3CUSH™ foam, a 70% biobased PU foam (Fates™) partially sourced from plants per the ASTM D6866-16 reference standard, The Lizzie offers a lower-profile sockliner that provides the boardfeel and impact protection you demand. LEGENDARY GRIP: The bottom plate design utilizes forefoot flex grooves, zonal waffle lugs for durability and support, plus SickStick™ rubber (a proprietary compound containing at least 55% responsibly sourced natural rubber obtained from sources that follow proven sustainable practices with the intention of reducing impacts on the planet) paired with a micro-waffle pattern, and gives you the grip you expect from Vans with a broken-in feel right out of the box. DURABILITY: DURACAP™ reinforcements in high-wear areas, plus a thicker 3D molded DURACAP™ toe cap, provide extra durability.
new_items.name: Vans The Lizzie Low (Vintage White/Black)

new_items.description: The Sk8-Hi was a game changer as the first high-top skate shoe to break onto the scene. With a padded collar for ankle support and reinforced toe caps, it remains a style like no other. The Sk8-Hi was Vans second model to showcase the Vans Sidestripe, and its bold design has remained iconic ever since.
new_items.name: Vans Sk8-Hi Color Theory Shoes

new_items.description: The Era hit the streets 50 years ago. Designed by skate pioneers, it was Vans first shoe made for skateboarding. An evolved take on the Authentic the Era’s trusted silhouette and performance-focused upgrades—from the padded collar to the grippy rubber outsole—helped take skateboarding to the next level in the late ‘70s. Over the decades that followed, it remained one of Vans' most sought-after styles. But now, the Era is out of the back catalog and back in the streets. Modernized with our latest skate tech, today’s Skate Era is reinforced and refined for the next generation.
new_items.name: Vans Skate Era Mauve Mist Shoes

new_items.description: Celebrating 25 years of Geoff Rowleys legacy, the Skate Rowley Shoe is a nod to his original signature shoe while pushing skate culture forward. Built on the Rowley Pro foundation and redesigned for todays skaters, this vulcanized classic delivers everything modern skateboarders need. Honoring a skate icon who reshaped shoe design, this anniversary edition stays true to its roots while keeping up with the demands of the next generation.
new_items.name: Vans Skate Rowley Shoes

new_items.description: Remixed 2000s nostalgia powered by today’s skate tech The Skate Mixxa channels the bold vibes of the early days when skate shoes were all about making a statement. We’re pulling from the Vans archives to drop a reimagined silhouette that brings a bit of nostalgia. With oversized ollie panels and DURACAP underlays for a pop of color that can weather a few drops, this sneaker fuses today’s tech with a retro aesthetic. Low-top puffy sneakers give you a retro look Skate-specific features for next-level durability and performance SickStick™ gum rubber gives you lasting grip that won’t quit Upper combines leather, polyethylene, and mesh for style and strength Stitched-on cupsole wraps the whole shoe for insane durability Reinforced toe cap for extra protection up front DURACAP™ ollie panel fortifies high-wear spots Lightly padded footbed keeps you comfy with every push Puffy collar and padded tongue bring that extra support Wide laces add to the classic vibe Color-blocked outsole delivers a unique twist on the design
new_items.name: Vans Skate Mixxa Skateboard Shoe - Athletic White/Multi

new_items.description: The Chukka Low Sidestripe, designed by the Vans skate team and inspired by classics like the Authentic and the Chukka Boot, brings a new heritage aesthetic to this old school skate shoe. Featuring our iconic sidestripe, this low top silhouette blends classic materials like sturdy suede and 6 oz twill with Vans original waffle outsoles made of a rubber that offers grip and support. Inside, enhanced sockliners provide superior cushioning and impact protection. Along with Pro Vulc Lite construction for lightweight comfort and flexibility, the Chukka Low Sidestripe delivers the best in boardfeel, flex, and traction. ENHANCED CUSHIONING - Enhanced sockliners offer superior cushioning and impact protection. CLASSIC GUM RUBBER GRIP - The Van Doren Gum Rubber Compound, made of a rubber that offers grip and support, is what attracted skaters to Vans in the first place. This is the Sole of Skateboarding. ULTIMATE BOARDFEEL, FLEX, AND GRIP - A lighter version of our iconic construction, Pro Vulc Lite features single-wrapped, high-wall vulcanization along with drop-in cushioning. Style #VN0A5KQZB8C1
new_items.name: Vans Chukka Low Sidestripe Skateboard Shoe - Black/Black/White
